name: Teeth of the Wicked
source:
The year is 199X, you return to your hometown after your mother's disappearance, and everyone thinks there's something dark lurking amongst their own neighbors. Unfortunately, they're right.

Stuck alone with an unpredictable grasp over your own strange powers, you try to find anyone else in town who shares a similar ability; without disappearing yourself.

[From [url=https://doughnutcleric.itch.io/teeth-of-the-wicked]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
199X年，母亲失踪后，你回到了家乡，每个人都认为自己的邻居中潜藏着黑暗的东西。不幸的是，他们是对的。

你独自一人，对自己奇怪的力量有着不可预测的掌控，你试图在镇上找到其他拥有类似能力的人；而不让自己消失。

[来自[url=https://doughnutcleric.itch.io/teeth-of-the-wicked]itch.io[/url]]
